description: Chat Improvements - Persistent conversation history per user, multi-turn context with reference to previous messages, source document highlighting showing which chunks were used, export chat as markdown, and chat with specific document or group scope.
steps: Step 1: Create app/models/chat.py with models: ChatSession(id, user_id FK, title, scope_type: 'global'|'document'|'group', scope_id: nullable int, created_at, updated_at), ChatMessage(id, session_id FK, role: 'user'|'assistant', content: text, sources_json: list of {doc_id, chunk_text, score}, created_at).

Step 2: Create app/schemas/chat.py with Pydantic schemas: ChatSessionCreate(title, scope_type, scope_id), ChatSessionResponse(id, title, scope_type, scope_id, created_at, message_count), ChatMessageResponse(id, role, content, sources, created_at), ChatSendRequest(session_id, message, scope_type, scope_id), ChatSendResponse(message: ChatMessageResponse, session: ChatSessionResponse), ChatExportResponse(format: 'markdown', content: str).

Step 3: Create app/services/chat.py with ChatService class: create_session(db, user_id, title, scope_type, scope_id) -> creates new chat session, send_message(db, session_id, user_id, message) -> retrieves conversation history from session, builds multi-turn context, performs scoped RAG search (filter by document_id or group_id if scoped), calls LLM with full conversation context, saves user message and assistant response with source chunks, returns response. get_sessions(db, user_id) -> list user's chat sessions. get_messages(db, session_id) -> full conversation. export_session(db, session_id, format) -> formats conversation as markdown.

Step 4: Create app/api/chat.py with endpoints: POST /api/chat/sessions (create session), GET /api/chat/sessions (list user's sessions), GET /api/chat/sessions/{id}/messages (get conversation), POST /api/chat/sessions/{id}/messages (send message - the main chat endpoint), GET /api/chat/sessions/{id}/export?format=markdown (export conversation), DELETE /api/chat/sessions/{id} (delete session). Keep the existing POST /api/chat endpoint working for backward compatibility.
Step 5: Register the chat router in app/api/router.py.

Step 6: Create tests/test_chat_enhanced.py with tests: create session, send message and get response with sources, multi-turn context maintains history, scoped chat filters by document_id, scoped chat filters by group_id, export session as markdown, list sessions returns user's sessions only, delete session removes all messages.
acceptance_criteria: Chat sessions persist conversation history per user
Multi-turn context sends previous messages to LLM for continuity
Source documents are tracked per message with chunk text and relevance scores
Chat can be scoped to a specific document or group
Export produces valid markdown with conversation formatted
Backward compatibility: existing POST /api/chat still works
Tests pass: uv run pytest tests/test_chat_enhanced.py -v
